name: Voices in Science: STEM Careers (middle school)
what_you_do: Meet scientists from the Burke and UW and explore a new STEM topic each week, such as fossil plants, rocks, oceans, birds, archaeology or medical physics.
who_can_apply: Students in grades 7 to 8 who are 13 or older. Priority goes to teens who want to build confidence in STEM and those with few STEM role models or science resources.
duration: Six Sundays, 2 to 5 p.m. (the 2026 session ran Oct 18 to Nov 22 at the Burke Museum)
deadline_text: Applications for the fall 2026 session closed Sept 25, 2026. Dates for 2027 are not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online when the next session opens (the 2026 form was linked from the page). Join the Burke's Youth and Family Programs e-newsletter for dates.
notes: High schoolers can look at the Burke's Burke-ology program for grades 9 to 12. Burke volunteering is for ages 18 and up.
